scope: Synthetic one-object native list dispatch, followed by explicit native RTV4 Init, Update and Draw before any explicit saved-redraw replay. Host bitmap, canvas, context, queue, renderer holder, allocator and loader adapters remain; this is not automatic page paint, saved-note or device evidence.
list: Native ordered list dispatch, supplied Matrix3 and 84 AddPoint calls asserted by adapter
runtime_limitations: Host EGL, GLES, Mesa drivers and transitive shared libraries are unpinned.
